init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode by reading RANK and WORLD_SIZE env vars and setting up NCCL backend
all_gather: gather arbitrary picklable data from all GPU ranks into a single list across processes
reduce_dict: reduce a dictionary of tensor values across all processes with optional averaging
setup_for_distributed: disable print output on non-master processes so only rank 0 prints to stdout
get_global_gloo_group: get a cached Gloo backend process group containing all ranks for CPU-based reduction
